errors.text_span: der hellblaue Balken (Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst) etwa 65 %, und der graue Balken (Öffentlicher Dienst) etwa 68 %
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the values for the light blue and gray bars for the category "Plattformdienste". The image shows the light blue bar is the longest at approx. 68% and the gray bar is shorter at approx. 66%. The description reverses this relationship by stating the light blue bar is 65% and the gray bar is 68%.
